title: Third-party plugins
description: Third-party plugins to install via each platform's native plugin system. Plugins with structured claude fields (marketplace_ref + plugin_id) are auto-installed by install.py; others are managed manually.

platforms.description: Keys are platform names: claude, codex, cursor.

install.description: If present, `install.py manual` symlinks this plugin's skills into user-level dirs. Absent => managed manually per-platform (install_cmd/note).

installConfig.description: Symlink-install declaration. Exactly one of `links` | `generate` (enforced by install.py). source = repo-relative submodule path.

links.description: Explicit user-level paths; each -> source root. For single-skill repos (e.g. anysearch). Mutually exclusive with generate.

generate.description: Discover skills then symlink each into link_dir + extra_links. Mutually exclusive with links.

generateConfig.description: Skill discovery + linking. Exactly one of (from+field) | scan_dir (enforced by install.py). link_dir is the primary platform dir; extra_links adds more dirs per skill.

from.description: Manifest path under source, e.g. .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Use with field. Mutually exclusive with scan_dir.

field.description: JSON key in the manifest whose value is a list of relative skill paths. Use with from. Mutually exclusive with scan_dir.

scan_dir.description: Dir under source to scan for subdirs containing a SKILL.md. For multi-skill repos whose manifest has no skill list. Mutually exclusive with from/field.

link_dir.description: Primary user-level dir to symlink each discovered skill into, e.g. ~/.agents/skills.

extra_links.description: Additional link_dirs; each discovered skill is also symlinked here, so one entry covers multiple platform dirs (e.g. ~/.claude/skills).

marketplace_ref.description: Claude marketplace source (GitHub repo or URL). Presence of this + plugin_id triggers auto-install by install.py.

plugin_id.description: Claude plugin identifier in plugin@marketplace form. Presence of this + marketplace_ref triggers auto-install by install.py.

install_cmd.description: Human-readable install/management note. For non-auto-installable platforms (codex/cursor) or manually-managed plugins.
